nodes.title: Open-world terrain tiles (read me first)
widgets_values:
A 4 km × 4 km island for an open world, delivered as 4 × 4 tiles, engine-agnostic:
  · Height: 2049² samples, 2 m per cell (a fine erosion pass at 2 m); each tile a 513² 16-bit PNG, **neighbouring tiles share the row of pixels on their common edge** (heights at the seams are bit-identical when stitched); metres = minimum + value × range, the range is in Height.json's range_scaled (one range for the whole map, the same for all tiles; the sea floor is negative). A full-map .r16 is included too.
  · Weight maps: seven layers Grass / ForestFloor / Sediment / Rock / Sand / Water / Road, one 8-bit greyscale PNG per tile per layer, **summing to 1 everywhere** (usable directly as the engine's terrain layers).
  · Instances: trees (3 pine and 2 broadleaf kinds, split by altitude), bushes, rocks (asset names match the SM_Rock_0N exported by the rock pipeline), written as CSV in 1024 m tiles, plus Instances_index.json listing each tile.
  · Roads in three classes: main roads between the towns (packed gravel, tall lamps as they near a town), town streets (granite setts, street lamps 28 m apart) and lanes (a dirt track, low lamps), each its own OBJ polylines and splat layer; 1 m terrain textures (BaseColor + normal) in 1024² tiles.
  · Water: the rivers and a dammed lake as a mesh of their own (flow in the vertex colour, uv in metres), one node per tile; the preview shows them reflecting the sky.
  · World.json (World Manifest): every file above, the coordinate convention and one manifest per tile for streaming; engine/unreal and engine/unity in the plugin read it.
  · AI: the road view's render with its depth and normal passes saved under concept/; the muted Concept group (select it, Ctrl+M) turns them into concept art with SDXL and a union ControlNet.
  · Towns: the buildings (Lot Subdivision → levelled pads → Building Generator) as one glb, a node per town.
  · Far view: the tree proxies as LOD chains ending in impostor cards (LOD Create) and their impostor atlases (Impostor Textures).
  · Trees: Tree Generator grows the conifer and the broadleaf (and a coarse variant of each for LOD1); the roads are swept into surface meshes (Roads_Mesh.glb, shoulders and pavements), the bridge has an arch.
  · Map.png: a stylized map with the town names, road classes, tiles, legend and scale bar.
  · Variants: the road view at dusk (lamps and windows lit), in the rain and under snow (variants/).
  · Flyby (muted: select the Flyby nodes, Ctrl+M): 240 frames along a path, saved as an animated WEBP.

Coordinate convention (written into every .json): origin at the north-west corner = top left of the height map, x east, z south (matching image row order), y up, units in metres. Instance transforms are read the same way as Copy to Points, so what the preview places is what the table says.

① Terrain, grown by its rivers: an island outline, a ridged uplift map (the main range) and a rock-hardness map → Stream Power at 513² with the sea as base level: the whole island rises while rivers cut it, hard rock stands as crags → HeightField Erode at 8 m (branching valleys, sediment on their floors) → resize to 1025² → buttresses and couloirs down the steep faces, gully pattern (erosion filter) → HeightField Erode → distort → erode again (Houdini's recipe; writes the flow, sediment and debris masks) → flow accumulation → river beds cut 1.5-5 m into the valley floors → town sites on flat low ground, a road network between them at a 10% grade (switchbacks on the hills), cut into the ground; each town's ground cut into lots, the lots levelled into pads, a building on each; farmland round the towns, its fields a Wave Function Collapse patchwork; then a fine HeightField Erode pass at 2 m (rills, small gullies, fans; roads, lots and beds kept) whose masks colour the surface. About five minutes on numpy, much less with CUDA.
② Ecology and colour from the erosion masks: cliffs above 55°, scree below them, sand on the beach and in the river beds, water in the sea and the trunk rivers, woodland in the valleys, grass that is lush where water collects, dry on the ridges and heath-coloured on the high ground, darker along every gully; the forest thins out over a soft edge with a belt of shrubs, ferns grow under the trees, and up high the trees are fewer and smaller.
③ Distribution: each of the three instance kinds scatters by its density map, samples height, picks an asset and sets orientation (trees upright with random rotation, rocks tilted a bit towards the slope).
④ Write files + preview: the full-map mesh with instance proxies, the buildings and a sea to the horizon, shot from the air in the Outdoor look (afternoon sun, clouds, haze).

# island outline: distance from the centre, pushed in and out by two scales of noise (bays, headlands)
dx = @u - 0.5
dy = @v - 0.5
r = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) * 2
coast = 0.78 + 0.45 * (noise(set(@u * 2.3, @v * 2.3, 1.7)) - 0.5) + 0.16 * (noise(set(@u * 7, @v * 7, 5.2)) - 0.5)
land = smoothstep(0.0, 0.10, coast - r)
# the sea is the rivers' base level (Stream Power's Outlet Layer)
@sea = 1 - smoothstep(0.0, 0.004, coast - r)
# uplift: a ridged spine (the main range) with spurs, massifs on it, low toward the coast
w1 = 0.6 * (noise(set(@u * 2.0, @v * 2.0, 7.7)) - 0.5)
rn = 1 - abs(2 * noise(set(@u * 2.2 + w1, @v * 2.2 - w1, 3.1)) - 1)
rn2 = 1 - abs(2 * noise(set(@u * 5.5 + w1, @v * 5.5, 8.8)) - 1)
pk = noise(set(@u * 3.1, @v * 3.1, 9.4))
@up = land * (0.15 + 0.9 * rn ** 3 + 0.25 * rn2 ** 2 + 0.6 * smoothstep(0.45, 0.8, pk)) * smoothstep(0.0, 0.5, coast - r + 0.15)
# rock (Stream Power's Erodibility Layer): hard cores and dykes stand as crags and cliffs (K x 0.6), soft basins
# wear into broad low valleys (K x 1.5)
hard = smoothstep(0.58, 0.68, noise(set(@u * 5, @v * 5, 2.2)))
dyke = smoothstep(0.93, 0.97, 1 - abs(2 * noise(set(@u * 4 + 0.5 * w1, @v * 9, 6.6)) - 1))
soft = smoothstep(0.55, 0.68, noise(set(@u * 3.3, @v * 3.3, 4.4)))
@kk = lerp(lerp(1.0, 1.5, soft), 0.6, max(hard, dyke))
@land = land
@C = lerp(-0.012, 0.004 + 0.01 * @C, land)

# buttresses and couloirs down the steep faces: sharp ridged noise across the slope (120 m and 45 m apart),
# stretched down it, up to ~25 m deep -- a steady-state slope is otherwise one smooth plane
x = @u * 4100
y = @v * 4100
hm = @C * 2048
gl = sqrt(@Nd.x * @Nd.x + @Nd.y * @Nd.y) + 1e-4
s = (x * (0 - @Nd.y) + y * @Nd.x) / gl
rib = 1 - abs(2 * noise(set(s / 120, hm / 260, 3.7)) - 1)
rib2 = 1 - abs(2 * noise(set(s / 45, hm / 110, 8.1)) - 1)
face = smoothstep(0.12, 0.35, 1 - @Nd.z) * @land
@C = @C + (25 * (rib * rib - 0.4) + 10 * (rib2 * rib2 - 0.4)) / 2048 * face
# hollows (60-150 m), rock roughness (10-50 m), on the land only; and a copy of the height for the mask blend
n1 = noise(set(@u * 34, @v * 34, 1.1)) - 0.5
n2 = noise(set(@u * 90, @v * 90, 2.3)) - 0.5
n3 = noise(set(@u * 220, @v * 220, 4.7)) - 0.5
@C = @C + (0.006 * n1 + 0.0025 * n2 + 0.001 * n3) * @land
# the same rock for the water as for the rivers: HeightField Erode's hardness (0-1) from Stream Power's K
@hard = clamp((1.5 - @kk) * 0.65, 0, 0.6)
@pre = @C

hm = @C * 2048
tn = normalize(set(@N.x, @N.z, -@N.y))
@tn = tn
# the up-ness the materials read: mostly the broad slope (Nb), a little of the 4 m one
@upb = lerp(@N.z, @Nb.z, 0.7)
# (the broad slope is gentler than the 4 m one: the thresholds below match the old shares of rock and soil)
steep = 1 - @upb
wet = clamp(@flow, 0, 1) * @land
hn = clamp(hm / (@C.max() * 2048), 0, 1)
@hn = hn
# water: the sea (below 0 m), and the trunk rivers (largest catchments) inside their beds
sea = 1 - smoothstep(-0.6, 0.3, hm)
big = smoothstep(0.003, 0.05, @catchment)
riv = max(@bed * smoothstep(0.25, 0.7, big), @lakew)
water = clamp(max(sea, riv), 0, 1)
# the fields: crops round the towns where the ground is gentle (the margins, field_id 0, stay grass)
fieldw = @farm * (1 - @town) * (1 - smoothstep(0.02, 0.06, steep)) * (1 - water) * clamp(@field_id, 0, 1)
pad = smoothstep(0.35, 0.9, @pad)
# cliffs: above ~55 degrees everywhere; from ~45 degrees on in patches (bare outcrops in the grass)
cliff = max(smoothstep(0.23, 0.34, steep), smoothstep(0.13, 0.2, steep) * smoothstep(0.5, 0.65, noise(set(@u * 40, @v * 40, 2.2)) + 0.2 * (noise(set(@u * 140, @v * 140, 5.5)) - 0.5)))
# sand: the beach (0-4 m above the sea, gentle), dry river beds and gravel bars
beach = (1 - smoothstep(2.5, 6.0, hm + 2.0 * (noise(set(@u * 25, @v * 25, 7.1)) - 0.5))) * (1 - smoothstep(0.065, 0.1, steep))
sand = clamp(max(beach, @bed * (1 - smoothstep(0.25, 0.7, big))), 0, 1)
# scree: what slumped (debris), below the cliffs
scree = smoothstep(0.0006, 0.003, @debris) * (1 - cliff)
# woodland: valleys and lower slopes where water collects, in clumps; not on cliffs, sand or scree
soil = (1 - cliff) * (1 - sand) * (1 - scree) * (1 - smoothstep(0.16, 0.27, steep))
cl_ = 0.55 * noise(set(@u * 6, @v * 6, 1.7)) + 0.25 * noise(set(@u * 26, @v * 26, 4.2)) + 0.45 * wet - 0.35 * hn + 0.06
clump = smoothstep(0.5, 0.62, cl_)
# the same clumps with a wide, soft edge: the band where the forest thins out into the open
woodsoft = smoothstep(0.36, 0.72, cl_)
# the fields are cleared of woodland (their margins keep it: hedgerows and copses)
wood = clamp(soil * clump, 0, 1) * (1 - fieldw)
# layer the seven weights: each takes its share of what the ones above left; the road first (fords and
# bridges cross the rivers), then water
road = clamp(@road, 0, 1)
@Road = road
rem = 1 - road
@Water = rem * water
rem = rem * (1 - water)
@Sand = rem * sand
rem = rem * (1 - sand)
@Rock = rem * cliff
rem = rem * (1 - cliff)
@Sediment = rem * scree
rem = rem * (1 - scree)
@ForestFloor = rem * wood
@Grass = rem * (1 - wood)
# the verges are kept clear (the cut and fill corridor)
# ... and so are the fields and the building lots
clear = (1 - smoothstep(0.05, 0.4, @rdw)) * (1 - 0.85 * @town) * (1 - fieldw) * (1 - pad) * (1 - @lane)
# orchards in the ring round each town (gentle, dry ground that is not a field or a lot), planted in rows
orch = smoothstep(0.12, 0.3, @tring) * (1 - smoothstep(0.3, 0.6, @town)) * (1 - smoothstep(0.03, 0.08, steep)) * (1 - water) * (1 - fieldw) * clear
@d_orchard = orch
# hedgerows along the field margins
@d_hedge = @farm * (1 - @town) * (1 - clamp(@field_id, 0, 1)) * (1 - smoothstep(0.02, 0.06, steep)) * (1 - water) * (1 - orch) * clear
# the forest edge is feathered, not a cut: trees thin out over the soft band, broken up by noise; and the
# tree line: fewer trees up high (they are also smaller there, see the trees Wrangle)
feather = soil * woodsoft * (1 - fieldw) * (1 - water) * smoothstep(0.25, 0.75, noise(set(@u * 90, @v * 90, 8.8)) + 0.5 * woodsoft - 0.25)
treeline = 1 - 0.85 * smoothstep(0.3, 0.65, hn)
@treeline = treeline
@d_tree = (max(@ForestFloor, 0.55 * feather) + 0.03 * @Grass * (1 - smoothstep(0.5, 0.7, hn))) * clear * (1 - orch) * treeline
edge_ = wood * (1 - wood) * 4
# shrubs in a belt round the woodland (the soft band's middle): the edge from forest to meadow
belt = woodsoft * (1 - woodsoft) * 4 * soil * (1 - water) * (1 - fieldw)
@belt = belt
# understory: ferns and low shrubs under the trees, in patches
@d_under = @ForestFloor * clear * (1 - orch) * smoothstep(0.3, 0.6, noise(set(@u * 60, @v * 60, 9.4))) * treeline
@d_bush = @Grass * (0.3 * edge_ + 0.3 * wet + 0.35 * smoothstep(0.55, 0.8, hn) + 0.6 * @farm * (1 - @town) * (1 - clamp(@field_id, 0, 1))) * smoothstep(0.35, 0.65, noise(set(@u * 23, @v * 23, 5.3))) * clear
@d_bush = @d_bush + 0.8 * belt * clear * (1 - orch)
@d_rock = (0.5 * @Sediment + 0.25 * @Rock * (1 - 0.6 * @Rock) + 0.1 * @Sand * @bed) * clear
@wet = wet
# colour (display values, made linear at the end)
rv = noise(set(@u * 9, @v * 9, 2.6))
# bedding on a tilted plane (as on the 1 m surface), faint: level bands would ring every peak
bedd = 0.5 + 0.5 * sin((hm + 820 * @u - 450 * @v) / 7 + 9 * noise(set(@u * 3, @v * 3, 6.1)))
rock = lerp(set(0.30, 0.29, 0.26), set(0.52, 0.51, 0.48), rv) * (0.88 + 0.14 * bedd)
rock = lerp(rock, rock * set(1.06, 0.98, 0.88), smoothstep(0.55, 0.8, noise(set(@u * 4, hm / 40, 3.3))))
rock = rock * (1 - 0.45 * smoothstep(0.3, 0.9, wet))
# a colour map out of the erosion masks (as in Project Pegasus): ridges and edges lighter, hollows darker
conv = smoothstep(-0.06, 0.06, @curv)
rock = rock * (0.78 + 0.4 * conv)
screec = set(0.58, 0.55, 0.50) * (0.88 + 0.24 * noise(set(@u * 80, @v * 80, 3.9)))
sandc = lerp(set(0.66, 0.60, 0.47), set(0.50, 0.46, 0.38), @bed) * (0.92 + 0.16 * noise(set(@u * 50, @v * 50, 8.1)))
sandc = lerp(sandc, sandc * 0.72, 1 - smoothstep(0.0, 1.2, hm))
# grass: lush in the valleys, dry yellow-green on sunny ridges, olive heath on the high ground
dry = clamp(0.6 * smoothstep(0.4, 0.8, noise(set(@u * 7, @v * 7, 4.4))) + 0.4 * steep * 4 - 0.9 * wet, 0, 1)
grass = lerp(set(0.17, 0.29, 0.09), set(0.36, 0.40, 0.17), dry)
grass = lerp(grass, set(0.33, 0.36, 0.20), smoothstep(0.55, 0.85, hn + 0.15 * (noise(set(@u * 12, @v * 12, 9.9)) - 0.5)))
grass = grass * (0.86 + 0.28 * noise(set(@u * 45, @v * 45, 7.7)))
# darker in the gullies (damp soil, shade-loving plants): the drainage pattern reads in the colour too
grass = grass * (1 - 0.28 * smoothstep(0.35, 0.9, wet))
# spurs dry and pale, hollows damp and dark; fresh sediment (the fans the water laid down) a pale silt-green
grass = lerp(grass * set(0.86, 0.92, 0.86), grass * set(1.12, 1.08, 0.9), conv)
grass = lerp(grass, set(0.46, 0.45, 0.30), 0.55 * smoothstep(0.003, 0.012, @sediment))
# the crops (a little mottled), and trodden ground on the building lots
grass = lerp(grass, @field * (0.9 + 0.2 * noise(set(@u * 200, @v * 200, 3.7))), 0.85 * fieldw)
grass = lerp(grass, set(0.46, 0.41, 0.33), 0.7 * pad)
woodc = set(0.15, 0.21, 0.09) * (0.85 + 0.3 * noise(set(@u * 60, @v * 60, 1.3)))
deep = smoothstep(0.0, -14.0, hm)
waterc = lerp(set(0.16, 0.36, 0.38), set(0.03, 0.10, 0.17), deep)
waterc = lerp(waterc, set(0.10, 0.19, 0.21), riv)
roadc = set(0.60, 0.53, 0.41) * (0.9 + 0.2 * noise(set(@u * 300, @v * 300, 6.4)))
c = grass * @Grass + woodc * @ForestFloor + screec * @Sediment + rock * @Rock + sandc * @Sand + waterc * @Water + roadc * @Road
@albedo = (c * (0.95 + 0.1 * noise(set(@u * 150, @v * 150, 2.2)))) ** 2.2
# the grass and rock colours on their own, for the 1 m surface textures
@grass_c = grass
@fieldw = fieldw
@rock_c = rock

# the 1 m surface: crisp material edges, rock strata and joints, rills, mottled grass; a detail height for the normal map
x = @u * 4100
y = @v * 4100
hm = @Ce * 2048
# the erosion filter's rills and spurs (metres): what it cut or left above the 4 m surface
ero = (@Ce - @C) * 2048
n4 = noise(set(x / 4, y / 4, 1.3))
n15 = noise(set(x / 15, y / 15, 2.9))
n50 = noise(set(x / 50, y / 50, 4.1))
# joint cracks (cell edges of a Worley pattern), only in patches
crk = (1 - smoothstep(0.0, 0.12, (@cr + 1) * 0.5)) * smoothstep(0.45, 0.6, n15)
# streaks and ribs down the faces: noise stretched along six fixed directions, each pixel taking the ones nearest
# its downhill direction (a per-pixel frame degenerates round a cone-shaped peak: the streaks became rings)
th = atan2(@N.y, @N.x)
st = 0 * x
rib = 0 * x
ws = 0 * x + 1e-6
for k, a in enumerate((0.0, 0.5236, 1.0472, 1.5708, 2.0944, 2.618)):
    w = pow(clamp(1 - abs(sin(th - a)) / 0.5, 0, 1), 2)
    sg = x * cos(a) + y * sin(a)
    sc = y * cos(a) - x * sin(a)
    st = st + w * noise(set(sc / 4, sg / 14, 5.5 + k))
    rib = rib + w * (1 - abs(2 * noise(set(sc / 9, sg / 28, 7.3 + k)) - 1))
    ws = ws + w
st = st / ws
rib = rib / ws
# crisp outcrops: the rock weight pushed past a ragged threshold; spurs (ero > 0) shed their soil first
land = 1 - @Water
rk = smoothstep(0.42, 0.58, @Rock + 0.55 * (n15 - 0.5) + 0.3 * (n4 - 0.5) + 0.06 * ero) * land
# the fine pass (2 m), as Gaea colours by its erosion masks: rock bared where the water wore the slope down,
# scree where slopes slumped, gravel and silt where the water dropped material, damper grass along its flow
wearm = smoothstep(0.3, 1.5, @wear) * smoothstep(0.12, 0.3, 1 - @upb)
depm = smoothstep(0.15, 1.2, @sedf * 2048) * (1 - smoothstep(0.25, 0.45, 1 - @upb))
debm = smoothstep(0.1, 0.8, @debf * 2048)
rk = max(rk, 0.85 * wearm * land * (1 - @Water))
k = where(land - @Rock > 1e-4, (land - rk) / max(land - @Rock, 1e-4), 0 * rk)
sd = @Sand * k
sc = @Sediment * k
ff = @ForestFloor * k
gr = @Grass * k
dm_ = clamp(0.6 * depm + 0.8 * debm, 0, 1) * (1 - rk)
sc = sc + (gr + ff) * dm_
gr = gr * (1 - dm_)
ff = ff * (1 - dm_)
# rock: beds of two thicknesses (5 m and 13 m, warped, terraced where the faces are hard), joint cracks, rough;
# colour banded by bed, lichen on the tops, dark streaks down the faces
# the beds lie on a tilted plane (dipping about 13 degrees), not on the contours: level beds drew rings round every
# peak like the grain of a sawn log
bedz = hm + 0.2 * x - 0.11 * y
sp = (bedz + 18 * (n50 - 0.5) + 5 * (n15 - 0.5)) / 5
band = sp - floor(sp)
sp2 = (bedz + 30 * (n50 - 0.5)) / 13 + 0.37
band2 = sp2 - floor(sp2)
hard = smoothstep(0.35, 0.65, noise(set(x / 140, y / 140, hm / 60)))
terr = (5 * (smoothstep(0.1, 0.9, band) - band) * (0.3 + 0.7 * hard) + 9 * (smoothstep(0.2, 0.8, band2) - band2) * (1 - 0.6 * hard)) * 0.6
# (the terraces stay in the colour only: in the relief they crossed the rills in zigzags on every face)
# rock in four layers, as a terrain material is built: cliff faces (the steepest: cool and dark, with couloirs),
# slabs (less steep: warm and lighter), moss on the flatter rock and the ledge tops, and stains hanging under the
# ledges. One layer with streaks everywhere read as brushed metal
slope = 1 - @upb
cliffw = smoothstep(0.21, 0.43, slope + 0.12 * (n15 - 0.5))
# couloirs in patches, not on every face
patch = smoothstep(0.38, 0.62, n50 + 0.4 * (noise(set(x / 30, y / 30, 2.2)) - 0.5))
# ledges: each 9 m bed crops out as a ledge over stretches of some 40-120 m (a noise of its own per bed), so the
# beds break the faces up without ringing the peak
bz = (bedz + 6 * (n50 - 0.5) + 2 * (n15 - 0.5)) / 9
lb = bz - floor(bz)
lat = smoothstep(0.5, 0.62, noise(set(x / 70, y / 70, floor(bz) * 2.3))) * (0.3 + 0.7 * hard)
shelf = lb - smoothstep(0.84, 0.98, lb)
lip = lat * smoothstep(0.86, 0.97, lb)
under = lat * smoothstep(0.35, 0.75, lb) * (1 - smoothstep(0.8, 0.88, lb))
# crags: angular blocks, each a Worley cell with a facet plane of its own, dark joints between them, at 8 m and
# 2.7 m -- the sharp-edged relief that keeps a face crisp from afar (smooth noise there reads as clay)
cq = set(x / 8 + 0.6 * (n15 - 0.5), y / 8 + 0.6 * (n4 - 0.5))
cw = worley(cq)
cdv = worley_dir(cq)
ca = rand(cw.z * 13.1) * 2 * PI
facet = (cdv.x * cos(ca) + cdv.y * sin(ca)) * (0.25 + 0.3 * rand(cw.z * 7.7))
joint = 1 - smoothstep(0.0, 0.07, cw.y - cw.x)
cq2 = set(x / 2.7 + 0.4 * (n4 - 0.5), y / 2.7)
cw2 = worley(cq2)
cdv2 = worley_dir(cq2)
ca2 = rand(cw2.z * 5.3) * 2 * PI
facet2 = (cdv2.x * cos(ca2) + cdv2.y * sin(ca2)) * 0.3
joint2 = 1 - smoothstep(0.0, 0.08, cw2.y - cw2.x)
cragw = (0.45 + 0.55 * hard) * (0.5 + 0.5 * cliffw)
crag = (4.5 * facet + 2.0 * facet2 - 0.5 * joint - 0.2 * joint2) * cragw
dr = (0 * terr - 0.8 * crk + 0.3 * (n4 - 0.5) + 0.6 * (n15 - 0.5) + crag
      + (2.2 * rib * rib * patch + 0.5 * (st - 0.5)) * (0.35 + 0.65 * cliffw) + 3.5 * lat * shelf)
bedc = 0.94 + 0.12 * noise(set(floor(sp) * 1.7, x / 300, 6.6))
base = @rock_c * bedc * (0.9 + 0.2 * n4) * (1 - 0.3 * crk)
# large zones of warmer and cooler rock (100-300 m)
zone = noise(set(x / 260, y / 260, 3.9))
base = lerp(base * set(0.93, 0.95, 1.02), base * set(1.08, 1.02, 0.9), smoothstep(0.35, 0.65, zone))
base = base * (0.84 + 0.32 * rand(cw.z * 3.3)) * (0.93 + 0.14 * rand(cw2.z * 2.1)) * (1 - 0.35 * joint * cragw)
cliffc = base * set(0.8, 0.82, 0.86) * (0.78 + 0.44 * rib * patch)
slabc = base * set(1.12, 1.06, 0.96) * (0.9 + 0.2 * n15)
rock = lerp(slabc, cliffc, cliffw)
# stains under the ledges, streaked down the face; the lips light
rock = lerp(rock, rock * set(0.62, 0.6, 0.58), 0.4 * under * smoothstep(0.4, 0.65, st))
rock = rock * (1 + 0.18 * lip)
# moss and lichen on the flatter rock and the ledge tops, in patches
moss = clamp(smoothstep(0.86, 0.92, @upb + 0.1 * (n15 - 0.5)) + 0.8 * lip, 0, 1) * smoothstep(0.4, 0.6, n4 + 0.3 * (n50 - 0.5))
rock = lerp(rock, lerp(base, set(0.30, 0.36, 0.20), 0.7), 0.75 * moss)
lich = smoothstep(0.62, 0.72, n4 + 0.4 * (n15 - 0.5)) * (1 - cliffw)
rock = lerp(rock, set(0.62, 0.62, 0.52), 0.35 * lich)
varn = under
# grass: mottled at 4 / 15 / 50 m, greener and darker in the rills, dry on the spurs, bare soil where the rill walls are steep
g = @grass_c * (0.72 + 0.4 * n15 + 0.2 * n4)
g = lerp(g, g * set(0.78, 0.9, 0.78), 0.5 * smoothstep(0.55, 0.95, @flowf))
# patches of a cooler, darker green (fern, scrub) and of a warmer one, at 50 m
g = lerp(g, g * set(0.75, 0.92, 0.85), smoothstep(0.55, 0.7, n50))
g = lerp(g, g * set(1.1, 1.0, 0.8), smoothstep(0.55, 0.7, 1 - n50) * 0.6)
g = lerp(g, g * set(1.06, 1.04, 0.9), smoothstep(0.5, 2.0, ero) * 0.3)
g = lerp(g, g * set(0.82, 0.92, 0.8), smoothstep(-0.5, -2.0, ero) * 0.4)
soilc = set(0.42, 0.35, 0.26) * (0.85 + 0.3 * n4)
bare = smoothstep(0.62, 0.75, n15 + 0.35 * smoothstep(0.07, 0.16, 1 - @upb) + 0.12 * ero) * (1 - @wet)
g = lerp(g, soilc, 0.85 * bare)
dg = 0.25 * (n4 - 0.5) + 0.15 * (n15 - 0.5)
# forest floor, scree (stones and gaps), sand (wet at the waterline), water
wood = set(0.14, 0.17, 0.08) * (0.75 + 0.5 * n4)
stn = (@cr + 1) * 0.5
scr = set(0.56, 0.53, 0.48) * (0.7 + 0.45 * smoothstep(0.0, 0.25, stn)) * (0.85 + 0.3 * n15)
dsc = 0.35 * smoothstep(0.0, 0.3, stn)
sand = lerp(set(0.68, 0.62, 0.49), set(0.40, 0.37, 0.31), @bed) * (0.92 + 0.12 * n4 + 0.08 * n15)
sand = lerp(sand, sand * 0.68, 1 - smoothstep(0.0, 1.5, hm))
deep = smoothstep(0.0, -14.0, hm)
wat = lerp(set(0.16, 0.36, 0.38), set(0.03, 0.10, 0.17), deep)
c = rock * rk + g * gr + wood * ff + scr * sc + sand * sd + wat * @Water
# the detail height (metres) for the normal map: rills strongest on soil, ledges and joints on rock
em = 0.2 + 0.4 * smoothstep(0.3, 0.7, n50)
dh = (em * ero * (1 - rk) * land + dr * rk + dg * gr + dsc * sc)
# the relief of the fine pass between the 4 m mesh vertices (the meshes carry the rest)
dh = dh + (@C - @C4) * 2048
# rills a little darker than the spurs between them
c = c * (1 + 0.04 * clamp(ero, -2, 2) * land)
# the roads, drawn at 1 m (the Road weight at 4 m is only a blur here): the other layers fill the rest,
# a worn verge, then packed dirt with gravel; flat in the normal map
wsum = rk + gr + ff + sc + sd + @Water
c = c / max(wsum, 0.05)
verge = clamp(@rdv - @rd, 0, 1) * land
c = lerp(c, c * set(0.9, 0.86, 0.78) + set(0.05, 0.04, 0.03), 0.6 * verge)
roadc = set(0.60, 0.53, 0.41) * (0.82 + 0.22 * n4 + 0.12 * (crk - 0.3)) * (1 - 0.15 * @wet)
c = lerp(c, roadc, @rd * land)
# the town streets are paved with setts (no ruts, no crown); the lanes are a darker dirt track
pave = clamp(@rdk, 0, 1) * land
trk = clamp(0 - @rdk, 0, 1) * land
c = lerp(c, set(0.40, 0.37, 0.30) * (0.85 + 0.2 * n4) * (1 - 0.15 * @wet), 0.8 * trk)
c = lerp(c, set(0.50, 0.49, 0.46) * (0.88 + 0.16 * n4 + 0.1 * (crk - 0.3)), pave)
ruts = @ruts * @rd * land * (1 - pave)
c = lerp(c, c * set(0.6, 0.56, 0.5), 0.9 * ruts)
crown = @crown * @rd * land * (1 - ruts) * (1 - pave)
c = lerp(c, set(0.36, 0.40, 0.20) * (0.8 + 0.3 * n4), 0.75 * crown)
dh = dh * (1 - @rdv * land) - 0.08 * ruts + 0.03 * crown
# the shore: a wet, darker band where the land meets the water, and surf streaks along the sea line
wetb = smoothstep(0.02, 0.3, @Water) * (1 - smoothstep(0.55, 0.85, @Water))
c = c * (1 - 0.35 * wetb)
foam = (1 - smoothstep(0.0, 0.55, abs(hm - 0.1))) * smoothstep(0.45, 0.75, noise(set(x / 3, y / 1.2, 8.8)) + 0.35 * (noise(set(x / 11, y / 11, 9.9)) - 0.5))
c = lerp(c, set(0.86, 0.89, 0.89), 0.75 * foam)
@terrain_albedo = clamp(c, 0, 1) ** 2.2
@dh = dh
@terrain_rough = lerp(lerp(lerp(0.92 - 0.15 * @wet * rk, 0.35, 0.7 * wetb), 0.05, @Water), 0.85, @rd * land)

ff = @ForestFloor * k
gr = @Grass * k
dm_ = clamp(0.6 * depm + 0.8 * debm, 0, 1) * (1 - rk)

slope = 1 - @N.z

bare = smoothstep(0.62, 0.75, n15 + 0.35 * smoothstep(0.1, 0.3, 1 - @N.z) + 0.12 * ero) * (1 - @wet)
verge = clamp(@rdv - @rd, 0, 1) * land

rdw_ = clamp(@rd, 0, 1) * land
st_ = min(clamp(@rds, 0, 1) * land, rdw_)

# grass: dry on sunny spurs and steep ground, lush where water collects, moss in the wettest hollows

# fbm(fx, fy, s, o): seamless fractal noise with fx × fy cells per metre (integers; unequal = stretched), seed s,
# o octaves; normalized to roughly unit variance (about -2.5..2.5), so thresholds read the same at any octave count
def fbm(fx, fy, s, o=4):
    t = 0
    a = 1.0
    n = 0
    for i in range(o):
        t = t + a * (pnoise(set(@u * fx, @v * fy, s + i * 7.13), set(fx, fy, 0)) - 0.5)
        n = n + a * a
        fx = fx * 2
        fy = fy * 2
        a = a * 0.5
    return t / (0.135 * sqrt(n))

# scratches: thin lines along a few directions. Directions use integer (a, b), so the rotated coordinates stay
# periodic over the 1 m tile; each line is cut into short pieces by noise along it
sc = 0
for k, (a, b, K) in enumerate(((1, 0, 23), (0, 1, 17), (1, 1, 19), (1, -1, 29), (2, 1, 13), (1, -2, 11))):
    along = a * @u + b * @v
    across = -b * @u + a * @v
    q = across * K + 0.2 * (pnoise(set(along * 8, across * K, k * 3.1), set(8, K, 0)) - 0.5)
    line = 1 - smoothstep(0.0, 0.0004 * K * sqrt(a * a + b * b), abs(frac(q) - 0.5))
    seg = smoothstep(0.62, 0.70, pnoise(set(along * 24, across * K, k * 5.7 + 2), set(24, K, 0)))
    sc = max(sc, line * seg)
@scratch = sc
@height = 0.00004 * fbm(220, 220, 3.3, 2) - 0.00008 * sc
